label: PowerEdge R750 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server with two 1GbE LOM ports, one OCP 3.0 slot on x8 PCIe lanes and a dedicated 1GbE iDRAC9 port. Up to eight PCIe Gen4 slots are available through riser and SNAP I/O options.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE LOM. OCP 3.0 (x8) for a 10/25GbE mezzanine card; up to 8x PCIe Gen4 slots for stand-up NICs/GPUs. Dedicated iDRAC9 Ethernet port.
